name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project depends on several factors, including the number of windows, their size, the type of windows being installed, and any structural adjustments required. For an average home, the actual installation often takes one to three days. However, the entire process, from initial consultation and measurement to manufacturing and final installation, can range from a few weeks to several months. Our team at Simply Construction provides a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project in Las Vegas.
